name: How long does a typical sliding door screen repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding door screen repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most sliding door screen repairs can be completed within 1 to 3 hours, depending on the complexity of the damage and whether the screen needs to be removed and taken to our workshop. Minor repairs like patching small holes are often done on-site quickly. Full screen mesh replacement might require taking the screen frame for rescreening. We strive to complete repairs efficiently to minimize disruption, and we'll provide an estimated completion time upon assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most repairs take 1-3 hours, depending on damage complexity. Minor fixes are quicker, while full rescreening might require off-site work.
